seo.title: Experimental Circular Home | Crio Creatives
seo.description: Architectural visualization of an experimental circular courtyard home, featuring its roof form, landscaped courtyard, living spaces, kitchen, bedrooms, bathroom and evening exterior.

hero.alt: Glass facade of the circular residence opening onto a landscaped courtyard with a fire pit
hero.description: A residence organized around a private circular courtyard, with a sweeping roof, fire-pit terrace and secluded spa deck.

sections.title: An inward-facing retreat.
paragraphs: The circular enclosure provides privacy while connecting the house to its own landscaped courtyard. A sweeping roof shelters the interior rooms and frames the shared outdoor space.
The design is presented through aerial, exterior, residential interior and evening visualizations.

sections.title: The Circular Form
paragraphs: A broad curved roof and perimeter wall frame a sheltered courtyard. Aerial views reveal how the residence, central lawn and outdoor areas fit together.
